castTime.quote: {{dv|{{tt|None|Ranged dash attack}}|{{tt|{{as|100% of '''Talon's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Talon|as_base}})*{{ccd|Talon|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})|Close dash attack}}}}
castTime.binNote: Ranged cast has no cast time (None). The close-range cast instead takes 100% of Talon's base attack windup time, a champion base stat not a fixed ability number, so no single number covers both cases; 0 is recorded for the default ranged case.

values.binNote: Bin computes CriticalDamage = LeapDamage * EnhancedDamageMod(1.5) + 1x bonus critDamage, i.e. (base+bonusAd)*1.5 rather than base*1.5 + bonusAd*1.5 as separate terms; the wiki's stated base (97.5..217.5) and 150% bonus AD ratio are algebraically equivalent to the bin's multiplicative formula, so the numbers agree.
wiki formula is by champion level 1-20 but bin's byLevel table is stated 9..55 over levels; treating as levels 1-18 with the same endpoints since champion levels cap at 18.

values.meaning: Bonus attack range granted on next basic attack, close range
values.quote: grants him {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}} on his next basic attack within 1 second
values.binNote: Not present in the datavalue sheet; the bin has no field for this bonus attack range or its 1s window.

mechanics.claim: If cast in melee range, the ability instead deals critical damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target is within melee range, '''Talon''' will {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} the target.

mechanics.claim: In close range, the cast is a stationary cast over the cast time, and damage is dealt at cast completion, not on dash arrival.
mechanics.quote: When cast in close range, ''Noxian Diplomacy'' deals its damage at the completion of the cast time, rather than at the dash's completion.

mechanics.claim: The close-range damage still lands even if the dash is interrupted, as long as the cast time finished.
mechanics.quote: The damage will be dealt even if '''Talon's''' dash is interrupted, so long as the cast time is completed.

mechanics.claim: Talon is ordered to basic attack the target at the end of the dash, which combined with the reset lets it chain into an auto attack.
mechanics.quote: ''Noxian Diplomacy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Talon's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: If the target dies at the moment the dash completes, the kill heal/cooldown refund still triggers (close range only).
mechanics.quote: ''Noxian Diplomacy'' will also grant the heal if the target dies upon '''Talon's''' completion of the dash.
